text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Tenno Sho (Autumn) just around the corner...
Vodka was called out by Daiwa Scarlet and headed toward "a certain place."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Welcome, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I thought I should talk to you properly
before the race. Just the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sure, but why the planetarium?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: If we don't change locations, it'll just end up like usual, won't it? We'll just be bickering back and forth.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine. I reserved the whole place,
so we can talk as freely as we like."
(Vrrrrm!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I really just don't get you
or the way you think."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just when you think she's heading for the Derby, she's back to the Tiara.
Next it's the Arima Kinen, then the mile route...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And next it's the Tenno Sho (Autumn)? If this were an astrological constellation, it'd be the Constellation of Absurdity!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Like hell a constellation like that exists!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I'm calling it nonsense because there isn't any!
I really don't understand
what you're even aiming for."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to beat you. But are you even taking this seriously?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't running just to compete
against you. But still..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"It's probably different, you know.
Your constellation and mine."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, different constellations?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"You've had this whole picture in your head from the start, haven't you?
Like, 'I'm a maiden, so of course it's Virgo♪' or something."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My constellation is different, though.
It's just a collection of random stars.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A hodgepodge of stars...?
Isn't that shape totally a mess?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Absurd is just fine.
What matters to me is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Because they're every single star, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Every single star...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Me and my Trainer, see... We've always just picked
the races we truly, from the bottom of our hearts, wanted to run at the time.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Junior GⅠs, the Oka Sho, the Derby, the Yasuda Kinen—every single one of them. Unforgettable showdowns, all of 'em.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
To someone like you who does everything according to plan,
this path might seem totally baffling.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But to me... to us, all of it matters!
We've got reasons we can't back down from!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My constellation...
is a collection of the absolute hottest stars.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A gathering of... blazing stars.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We've seen all kinds of stars
that you'd never see just by walking normally.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Connecting those stars makes up my constellation. Even if they're scattered, each individual star is massive.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"You just don't know how amazing that is.
It's as simple as that."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
L-Like I'd know that!
There's no way I could—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: We'll find out at the Autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm heading to the Tenno Sho
to show that to you."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"From the perspective of your royal road, I'm just erratic stardust.
But to me, that path is more precious than anything!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "With my own running style that I've finally mastered, I'm going to clash with you at your best! In a grand race called the Tenno Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I swore...
I wouldn't stand before you again
until I became someone I could be proud of."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And now, the time has come.
That's why I'm standing before you like this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: How's that? Still think I'm no match for you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Right, it makes no sense at all. My head
understands, but my heart doesn't. Still...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because we can't understand each other, it's great, right?
There's no point in competing against someone you fully understand.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Because when it comes down to those who truly get it, number one me is bound to win.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So you really are... my rival.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fine, bring it on! My running against yours...
This time, it's a real showdown!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's settle this.
Both of us are pumped up and fully tuned!
The stronger one wins!!
